design.target: CA3 single-pulse inhibitory difference -13.8±2.4mV, Figure3 Chevaleyre&Siegelbaum2010
design.scope: Scale only four CA2 inhibitory populations to CA2 pyramidal population; preserve all exported inhibitory-to-inhibitory synapses.
design.reason: Calibration measures a pyramidal postsynaptic response. Global inhibitory scaling changes unmeasured interneuron circuitry and its stiff dynamics; all-inhibitory gain candidate failed numerical spike-count convergence.
design.reversal_status: Assumption from recording recipe; require -75/-80 sensitivity.
design.selection: Closest non-spiking single-pulse inhibitory difference to target; no functional outcome used. After selection, recheck unused100Hz train and RK4precision.
design.warning: Fitted aggregate conductance multiplier is phenomenological, not a measured or original exported parameter.
design.zero_gain_role: Control with only inhibitory-to-pyramidal weights zero; inhibitory-to-inhibitory weights remain exported.

note: Calibration, not independent validation. Model neurons are not animal replicates. Extreme gain is a model-adequacy warning.
